modules.module_title: Perform identification and upkeep of construction materials, testing tools and equipment

pcs.pc_description: identify construction materials such as cement, fine and coarse aggregate, bricks, steel, bitumen, admixtures, concrete blocks, paver block, timber, plywood & steel reinforcement bar etc.

identify testing tools and accessories such as measuring jar, gauging trowel, measurement tape, metal scale, scoop, tray, tamping rod, stop watch, brushes, funnel, thermometer, Vernier calipers, IS sieves of different size, trowel, spade, pickaxe, vibrator etc.

identify apparatus and equipment required for cement and concrete testing such as Vicat apparatus & accessories, GI Sieves, Digital weighing balance drying oven and cube moulds, compression testing machine, flow table, laboratory concrete mixer, slump test cone etc.

identify apparatus and instruments required for soil testing such as hydrometer, standard sieves of different size, compaction test apparatus, rapid moisture content meter, CBR testing machine, liquid & plasticity limit test apparatus

identify apparatus and instruments required for aggregate testing such as flakiness gauge, elongation gauge, ring and ball apparatus, pycnometer, impact value test apparatus, crushing value test apparatus & Los Angeles abrasion test apparatus
identify apparatus and instruments required for bitumen testing such as penetrometer, bitumen compactor, Marshall stability test apparatus
identify apparatus ,instruments, chemicals required for water testing
clean, inspect and care for the construction materials, testing tools and equipment used for quality testing.

modules.module_title: Handle and store construction material for testing at the laboratory

pcs.pc_description: follow instructed methods/set guidelines for collection and handling of material samples such as cement, steel, sand, aggregate, soil, admixtures, brick, concrete blocks and distilled water

follow specified procedure for sampling, packing and tagging of materials for testing

modules.module_title: Collect/extract soil , concrete and bitumen samples from field

pcs.pc_description: extract soil samples using core cutters , pack & label the sample as per standard procedure and transport it to test laboratory
collect hot bitumen sample from construction site as per instructions, pack & label the sample as per standard procedure and transport it to test laboratory
collect and cast concrete cube samples at site as per standard procedure and instructions

modules.module_title: Prepare test samples, tools, and test apparatus for cement, concrete, bricks, and aggregates testing and provide support in testing

pcs.pc_description: prepare all tools and accessories required for cement, concrete, brick and aggregate testing for sample preparation and testing as per instructions
collect the required/ instructed quantity of sample of cement, concrete, brick and aggregate as per instructions
measure instructed quantity of sample to be tested in the site laboratory
cast cement and concrete cube samples in site laboratory as per standard procedure and instructions
prepare cement test samples and provide support in slump test, consistency test ,initial & final setting time test, fineness test and soundness test as per instructions
carry out sieve analysis and prepare test samples for specific gravity, crushing value, impact value test, abrasion value for coarse aggregate as per instructions
provide support in carrying out water absorption test and compressive strength test of cement cube, concrete cube, brick, concrete block & paver block

modules.module_title: Prepare test samples, tools, and test apparatus for bitumen testing and provide support in testing.

pcs.pc_description: prepare all required tools and accessories of bitumen testing for sample preparation and testing as per instructions
collect the required/ instructed quantity of sample of bitumen as per instructions
measure instructed quantity of bitumen sample to be tested in site laboratory

prepare bitumen test sample and provide support in content test, penetration test, specific gravity test, softening point test, flash & fire point, Marshall stability test of bitumen mixture as per instructions

modules.module_title: Prepare test samples, tools, and test apparatus for soil testing and provide support in testing.

pcs.pc_description: prepare all required tools and accessories of soil testing for sample preparation and testing as per instructions
collect the required/ instructed quantity of sample of soil as per instructions
measure instructed quantity of sample to be tested in site laboratory
prepare soil test samples and provide support in test for specific gravity, bulk density, moisture content, Atterberg limits, and silt content of soil as per instructions

modules.module_title: Perform housekeeping and dispose waste

pcs.pc_description: clean tools, apparatus, instrument, and accessories and place them at the appropriate location after use
upkeep all tools, apparatus, instrument, and equipment as per requirement
dispose the tested construction materials as per instructions
